title: Authenticate repeated from-list lazy imports
objective: Make warm sealed optimizer profiling authenticate already-loaded Python from-list imports without inventing pseudo-submodules, with exact fail-closed regression tests

handoff.summary: Warm sealed profiling now retains session-local negative lazy-module resolutions established during preparation, so repeated CPython-style from-list child probes preserve ImportError semantics instead of being misclassified as late code loads. Focused regressions cover the prepared pseudo-child lookup, and the authentic cubic factor-base profile completes with all 49 artifacts authenticated and no late artifacts.
risks: The negative-resolution memory is deliberately scoped to one optimizer profile session; ordinary evaluator import behavior is unchanged.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this commit into the integration branch, rebuild the TypeScript runtime, and regenerate the authenticated cubic factor-base receipt there.
